title: Invoices
summary: Upload vendor invoices, returns and transfers. Each is saved, shared on WhatsApp and emailed to {pos}.

items: Pick the **vendor** and the type: Invoice, Return, Something else or Transfer.
Add the total if you like.
Attach the file: a PDF or a photo.

blocks.text: Submit is instant: it only saves the record and the file. Right after, in the background, two things happen for every type except a transfer: a WhatsApp message goes to the staff group with a link to the file, and an email goes to {pos}'s invoicing inbox with the file as a PDF (a photo is turned into a PDF). {pos} turns that email into a draft bill.

items: Each upload shows Sending, Sent or Failed for WhatsApp and for the {pos} email, live.
Your upload is always saved, even if a send fails. A failed one gets **Resend**.

blocks.text: **Transfer** is for stock moved between the store and the Container. Pick the direction. A transfer goes to WhatsApp only, never to {pos}, and never counts as a vendor delivery.

Someone still has to enter each invoice in {pos} and mark it closed here. When a later upload shows {pos} received a delivery from that vendor after the invoice, it is listed under **Looks closed in {pos}** with the reason. **Mark closed in {pos}** closes it; **Not closed yet** hides the suggestion. Nothing is closed by itself.
A deleted upload goes to **Trash**, where an admin can restore it or delete it for good. Staff ask for a delete with Delete requested, and an admin approves or rejects it.
